name: 音声書籍の章と長さの一覧
prompt: Recreate this Japanese audiobook chapter-list screen as a single 390×730 portrait image. The native Japanese preview is authoritative for exact layout, copy, crop, positions, text size and state. The attached user image is palette preference only; do not copy its geometry. Keep a pure white canvas and white list surface with no tinted backgrounds, panels, or fills. Preserve the three top tabs, active underline, green play control, all ten chapter rows, durations, and right-side ellipsis controls. Keep the selected tab underline and play button as flat solid forest green matching the source (#047857). Keep chapter titles near-black, durations and ellipses neutral gray, and all other surfaces white. No gradients, color washes, shadows, cards, overlays, status bar, bottom navigation, additional icons or copy. Preserve exact Japanese text and order: 本について; 章の一覧; 関連する本; はじめのクレジット — 39秒; 献辞 — 39秒; 巻頭のことば — 14秒; 読者への手紙 — 4分; 第1部：自分らしく走り始める — 6秒; 第1章：走り切る力 — 11分; 第2章：子どもの頃の好きなこと — 7分; 第3章：弱さを受け入れる — 3分; 第4章：大切な人に声をかける — 7分; 第5章：私たちは似ている — 6分. Keep the source row spacing and typography; do not translate the Japanese content.
reviewNotes: White/no-tint palette is preserved; tab/list anchors and lower margin need one geometry correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
